readerCopy.body: Anger becomes more useful when it reveals the request, rule, or expectation that has stopped being tolerable. When Mars conjoins Lilith, action and refusal fuse, making a long-suppressed no much harder to keep smiling through. The reaction may be larger than today's offense because today's offense is not the whole history. The strongest use of the force is the boundary that changes participation in the part causing the resentment rather than destruction of the entire arrangement.
